question: For these TCGA cohorts and their tissues of origin: liver hepatocellular carcinoma (liver), kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (kidney), pancreatic adenocarcinoma (pancreas), lung adenocarcinoma (lung), breast invasive carcinoma (breast), colon adenocarcinoma (colon), stomach adenocarcinoma (stomach), prostate adenocarcinoma (prostate), ovary serous cystadenocarcinoma (ovary), thyroid carcinoma (thyroid gland), glioblastoma multiforme (brain), testicular germ cell tumor (testis): give the number of validated favourable and validated unfavourable prognostic genes, and how many of each are tissue enriched in the tissue of origin. Draw a grouped bar chart of the four counts per cohort and provide the table.

turns.text: Now let me determine tissue enrichment. I'll compute the top-expressing tissue per gene from the consensus data and combine with the HPA tissue-specificity label.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT Gene, Tissue, TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) AS n,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Gene ORDER BY TRY_CAST(nTPM AS DOUBLE) DESC) AS rn
  FROM rna_tissue_consensus
),
top1 AS (SELECT Gene, Tissue AS top_tissue FROM ranked WHERE rn=1),
pa AS (SELECT Gene, "RNA tissue specificity" AS spec FROM proteinatlas),
origin(Cancer, t) AS (
  SELECT 'Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA)','liver' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (TCGA)','kidney' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','pancreas' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Lung Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','lung' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Breast Invasive Carcinoma (TCGA)','breast' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Colon Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','colon' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Stomach Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','stomach' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Prostate Adenocarcinoma (TCGA)','prostate' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma (TCGA)','ovary' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Thyroid Carcinoma (TCGA)','thyroid gland' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Testicular Germ Cell Tumor (TCGA)','testis' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','amygdala' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','basal ganglia' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','cerebellum' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','cerebral cortex' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','choroid plexus' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','hippocampal formation' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','hypothalamus' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','midbrain' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Glioblastoma Multiforme (TCGA)','spinal cord'
),
genelist AS (
  SELECT Gene, Cancer, 'fav' AS typ FROM cancer_prognostic_data
   WHERE "validated prognostic - favorable" <> '' AND Cancer IN (SELECT Cancer FROM origin)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT Gene, Cancer, 'unfav' AS typ FROM cancer_prognostic_data
   WHERE "validated prognostic - unfavorable" <> '' AND Cancer IN (SELECT Cancer FROM origin)
)
SELECT g.Cancer,
  SUM(CASE WHEN typ='fav' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fav_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN typ='unfav' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unfav_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN typ='fav' AND o.t IS NOT NULL AND pa.spec='Tissue enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fav_enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN typ='unfav' AND o.t IS NOT NULL AND pa.spec='Tissue enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unfav_enriched
FROM genelist g
LEFT JOIN top1 ON top1.Gene = g.Gene
LEFT JOIN pa ON pa.Gene = g.Gene
LEFT JOIN origin o ON o.Cancer = g.Cancer AND o.t = top1.top_tissue
GROUP BY g.Cancer
ORDER BY g.Cancer"}

turns.text:
## Method

Counts come from the **cancer_prognostic_data** table (Human Protein Atlas bulk file), using the TCGA cohorts only. A gene counts as a "validated prognostic favourable/unfavourable" gene when the corresponding `validated prognostic – favourable` / `validated prognostic – unfavorable` field is non-empty.

"Tissue enriched in the tissue of origin" was determined by: (1) taking the HPA `RNA tissue specificity` label = **Tissue enriched** (from the proteinatlas table), and (2) requiring the gene's top-expressing tissue in the consensus normal-tissue dataset (`rna_tissue_consensus`) to be the cohort's tissue of origin (liver, kidney, pancreas, lung, breast, colon, stomach, prostate, ovary, thyroid gland, testis; for glioblastoma the brain-region tissues amygdala / basal ganglia / cerebellum / cerebral cortex / choroid plexus / hippocampal formation / hypothalamus / midbrain / spinal cord).

| Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma | liver | 113 | 939 | 45 | 0 |
| Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma | kidney | 1639 | 264 | 16 | 0 |
| Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma | pancreas | 4 | 134 | 0 | 0 |
| Lung Adenocarcinoma | lung | 5 | 202 | 0 | 0 |
| Breast Invasive Carcinoma | breast | 5 | 4 | 0 | 0 |

final_answer:
## Method

Counts come from the **cancer_prognostic_data** table (Human Protein Atlas bulk file), using the TCGA cohorts only. A gene counts as a "validated prognostic favourable/unfavourable" gene when the corresponding `validated prognostic – favourable` / `validated prognostic – unfavorable` field is non-empty.

"Tissue enriched in the tissue of origin" was determined by: (1) taking the HPA `RNA tissue specificity` label = **Tissue enriched** (from the proteinatlas table), and (2) requiring the gene's top-expressing tissue in the consensus normal-tissue dataset (`rna_tissue_consensus`) to be the cohort's tissue of origin (liver, kidney, pancreas, lung, breast, colon, stomach, prostate, ovary, thyroid gland, testis; for glioblastoma the brain-region tissues amygdala / basal ganglia / cerebellum / cerebral cortex / choroid plexus / hippocampal formation / hypothalamus / midbrain / spinal cord).

## Table — validated prognostic genes per TCGA cohort

| TCGA cohort | Tissue of origin | Validated favourable | Validated unfavourable | Favourable & tissue-enriched in origin | Unfavourable & tissue-enriched in origin |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma | liver | 113 | 939 | 45 | 0 |
| Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma | kidney | 1639 | 264 | 16 | 0 |
| Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma | pancreas | 4 | 134 | 0 | 0 |
| Lung Adenocarcinoma | lung | 5 | 202 | 0 | 0 |
| Breast Invasive Carcinoma | breast | 5 | 4 | 0 | 0 |
| Colon Adenocarcinoma | colon | 5 | 3 | 0 | 0 |
| Stomach Adenocarcinoma | stomach | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Prostate Adenocarcinoma | prostate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma | ovary | 0 | 17 | 0 | 0 |
| Thyroid Carcinoma | thyroid gland | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Glioblastoma Multiforme | brain | 12 | 57 | 0 | 0 |
| Testicular Germ Cell Tumor | testis | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Grouped bar chart (counts per cohort)

The four counts per cohort (values scaled: 1 block ≈ 50 genes; totals shown in the table above):

```
                    VALIDATED FAVOURABLE (blue)          VALIDATED UNFAVOURABLE (red)
                    total      origin-enriched           total        origin-enriched
LIHC (liver)        ██ 113     █ 45                      ███████████████████ 939   0
KIRC (kidney)       █████████████████████████████████ 1639  █ 16          █████ 264            0
PAAD (pancreas)     0          0                         ███ 134      0
LUAD (lung)         0          0                         ████ 202     0
BRCA (breast)       0          0                         0            0
COAD (colon)        0          0                         0            0
STAD (stomach)      0          0                         0            0
PRAD (prostate)     0          0                         0            0
OV   (ovary)        0          0                         0            0
THCA (thyroid)      0          0                         0            0
GBM  (brain)        0          0                         █ 57         0
TGCT (testis)       0          0                         0            0
```

*(A literal grouped bar chart is not renderable in this text interface; the ASCII bars above and the table give the exact numbers. In a plotting tool the four series per cohort are: validated favourable total, validated unfavourable total, favourable tissue-enriched, unfavourable tissue-enriched.)*

## Key observations

- **Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma (kirc)** has by far the most validated favourable prognostic genes (**1639**), of which **16** are kidney tissue-enriched, and **264** validated unfavourable (none tissue-enriched).
- **Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (lihc)** has **113** validated favourable genes (**45** liver tissue-enriched — the largest tissue-enriched count of any cohort) and **939** validated unfavourable genes (**0** liver tissue-enriched).
- **Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma** (4 / 134), **Lung Adenocarcinoma** (5 / 202), **Breast Invasive Carcinoma** (5 / 4), **Colon Adenocarcinoma** (5 / 3) and **Glioblastoma Multiforme** (12 / 57) all have small numbers of validated prognostic genes, with **zero** tissue-enriched in their tissue of origin.
- **Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma** has 0 favourable and 17 unfavourable; **Stomach, Prostate, Thyroid and Testicular Germ Cell Tumor** cohorts have **no** validated prognostic genes at all in the TCGA dataset.
- Across all 12 cohorts, no cohort had any **validated unfavourable** gene that was tissue-enriched in its tissue of origin.
